verdict.rationale: Honeybadger offers an in-product AI-assisted search feature ("Describe your search" panel) that turns natural-language descriptions into BadgerQL queries, and anomaly detection that flags statistically unusual error rates — both are data-driven insights surfaced inside the product. However, these are narrow, single-feature capabilities rather than broad AI-generated insights/suggestions across the whole dataset, and the more comprehensive AI interaction (querying Insights data, investigating errors) is delivered via the external MCP integration for AI assistants rather than natively inside the product UI. Missing for 10: broader AI-generated insights/dashboards, evidence of AI-based error analysis beyond search-query generation, and independent/hands-on validation of the AI search or anomaly detection quality.
